    Finite category and algebra Auslander--Reiten surplus #

    The projective-generator equivalence pulls a finite algebra-module skeleton back to a duplicate-free complete skeleton of finite category modules. The generic finite-tau equivalence theorem then identifies its surplus with the literal ambient algebra surplus used by primitive directed deletion.
